params.body:
Replaces #354; close #354 unmerged.

The page now opens with one sentence on whether it is safe, and everything else folds under "Details".

| Verdict | Colour | When | Example sentence |
|---|---|---|---|
| safe | green | otherwise | "Safe. Nothing can change a live system; code waits for your merge." |
| live | amber | an admission for the repair layer is in force | "The workbench, on the laptop and at home may repair on Stocklistdealer.eu platform until 23:59." |
| unsafe | red | the page cannot vouch for what the gateway allows | "The gateway runs an older permission for the workbench at home than Elixir wrote; carry it over." |

The live verdict covers the one kind of admission that changes a system without a merge in between. The unsafe verdict covers:

- no report from Elixir;
- a report older than 2.5 hours;
- a gateway that did not answer;
- a gateway serving another grant than Elixir wrote. Such a grant can be wider, so this counts as unsafe.

When the verdict is unsafe, the details open by themselves; they carry the carry-over commands.

Inside the details is the per-project view from #354: which hand may do what on each project, dark when admitted now, grey when it waits for the owner's word. Below it come the hands and a legend of the action types.

Tests: `GrantsOverviewTest` covers the three verdicts. The full suite passes 621 of 622; the one failure, `BuildStampTest`, also fails without this change because it reads the git checkout. PHPStan reports 0 errors.
